description: A Kotlin source file implementing an Android TV content info screen using Jetpack Compose. It defines an activity that displays metadata about a media item, including title, description, and action buttons with focus behavior suitable for TV interfaces.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying content information, handling intent extras and setting up the Jetpack Compose UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, retrieves extras, and creates ComposeView with content info screen.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back button press to finish activity.

methods.name: ContentInfoScreen
methods.description: Composable function rendering the detailed content info layout, including metadata, description, and focusable action buttons.

methods.name: MetaText
methods.description: Displays a piece of metadata text with specified color and styling.

methods.name: MetaDivider
methods.description: Displays a separator ' | ' between metadata items.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: Creates a styled badge with text, background, and corner rounding.

methods.name: ActionItem
methods.description: Data class representing an icon and label for an action button.

methods.name: ActionPillButton
methods.description: Composable that renders a focusable pill-shaped button with icon, handling focus states and key events for TV navigation.
